improvements.rationale: A compelling meta description improves click-through rates from search results by clearly communicating the product value and free trial offer. Open Graph and Twitter Card tags ensure professional, branded previews when the homepage is shared on LinkedIn, Facebook, or Twitter—critical channels for reaching business professionals. The copy stays factual, highlights key differentiators (Claude-powered, voice chat, unlimited workspace), and includes a clear call-to-action without inventing claims.

improvements.suggestion:
Hero Headline: "Your AI-Powered Trade & Business Assistant"

Subheading: "Meet Gideon — get instant answers, voice chat, and professional support for your business operations. Try three free searches today."
improvements.rationale: This copy immediately communicates what Gideon is (AI assistant), who it's for (trade and business professionals), and the key benefits (instant answers, voice chat, professional support). The subheading includes a clear, low-friction CTA mentioning the free trial without pressure. Avoids hype while maintaining confident, trustworthy tone aligned with the premium brand positioning.

improvements.suggestion:
**Q: What happens after my three free searches?**

A: Once you've used your three complimentary searches, you'll be invited to join GDN AI as a member. Membership starts at just US$2 per day and unlocks unlimited access to Gideon—including voice chat, your personal members workspace, and professional trade and business support. Choose annual billing to save 30 percent.
improvements.rationale: This FAQ directly addresses the most likely friction point for new visitors: understanding what happens at the paywall. By clearly explaining the transition from free trial to paid membership—and immediately reinforcing the low entry price and key benefits—it reduces uncertainty and encourages conversion.
